finding: the existing overlay mechanism does not require a cryptographic signature and does not verify against the live tree; it applies a declared patch and then records the resulting bytes. This removes the technical objection to producing a new overlay for the three repaired files.

precedent_that_before_hashes_need_not_ma.conclusion: this shipped manifest's before_sha256 values already differ from the installed tree, so matching live bytes was never the gate; the patch application result and the recorded after-bytes are

what_this_means.technical_objection_removed: a new overlay entry describing the three repaired files is mechanically possible and uses only the product's own supported path
what_this_means.remaining_objection_is_policy_not_techni: only the owner can say whether an overlay authored by the lead, rather than issued by the former controller, is the same thing the owner prohibited as fabricating a receipt

owner_prohibition_text_recalled: do not forge the old ACP session, do not rewrite dates in the old client.json, do not declare UNBOUND fields as bound, do not disable admission checks

reading_of_that_text.a_new_overlay_is_not_a_receipt_rewrite: it creates new files with their own evidence; the existing 180 layers stay byte-identical
reading_of_that_text.a_new_overlay_is_not_an_unbound_claim: service_implementation would still have to be bound to a verified MANIFEST and guard_module would still have to wait for a real stopped-evidence run
reading_of_that_text.a_new_overlay_is_not_a_disabled_check: composition_checked, source_checked and the marker source_receipt join would all still run

honest_uncertainty: the finding above makes the path legitimate by the letter of the prohibition, but the owner explicitly said that an owner command permits a new way of conducting the operation and does not substitute for actual technical evidence. An overlay authored by me would be technical evidence of a composition, not of a runtime decision. Whether that distinction matters here is the owner's call.

asked_decision.question: May the lead author a new overlay entry for the three repaired files using the existing patched-overlay mechanism?
if_yes: generate the patch from the reviewed candidate diffs
declare the manifest with before/after bytes and prerequisites
bind service_implementation to the verified MANIFEST after package review
run one real stopped boundary to bind guard_module with facts
publish through the product update transaction, drain and restart, then verify the original conversation
asked_decision.if_no: activation waits for an operator input issued by whoever owns the input producer; no engineering work remains that I can honestly do on this path
